dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent C-shaped structure at the upper-right quadrant with a sharp dark exterior boundary transitioning to a high-intensity interior; two irregular O-shaped annuli at the dorsal-center with fragmented perimeters and gradual internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated cluster of high-intensity, amorphous blobs in the central region; a large, high-intensity solid patch is visible on the far right terminal edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli form an elongated scalene triangle with the primary vertex oriented toward the dorsal-anterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Interconnected filigree-like patterns forming a complex reticulated web across the mid-dorsal region.
